input.question: how do i initiate rework for a job

excerpts.title: Initiate Job Rework
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Authorized business writers can create Rework for a completed Production Job. Open the Job in Production and select Create Rework. Choose a Reason, describe Rework Scope / Work Required, enter Intake / Return Date, then select Create Rework. The Job must be complete, unarchived and have no active Rework cycle. Only one Rework cycle can be active at a time. Rework remains on the same canonical Job and preserves original Production status and dates. Scope is a whole-Job description, not structured piece or Color Plate tracking.

excerpts.title: Production Rework lifecycle and requirements
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Rework belongs to an existing canonical Production Job. Only one active Rework is allowed; eligible Job states and the actual Create Rework action remain authoritative. TenOps models Rework as a lifecycle belonging to one canonical commercial Production Job. The Job number, customer, commercial values, documents, attachments, Purchase Orders, Transmittals, and Job Updates remain job-scoped. The original lifecycle remains on jobs; Rework never overwrites its status or planned dates. Only one Rework can be active for a Job, while completed and cancelled cycles remain historical. input.question: how do i filter manpower reporting by job

excerpts.title: Filter Manpower Reporting by Job
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Employees with business-write access can filter labor by Production Job. Open Reporting → Manpower Reporting, then choose the Job in Job labor review. Use Clear job filter or All reporting groups to reset. After selecting a Job, Product Category filter narrows products. Analytics use the selected reporting period; reporting rows are loaded complete groups with all their dates. Search and filters are not exhaustive until all available history is loaded. Read-only accounts cannot change the current Job labor review selector, but can use Search manpower or open a Job’s Current Hours link from Production.

excerpts.title: Manpower Reporting work identity and filters
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Job dropdown filtering uses business-write-gated controls in the released UI. Read-only accounts retain search/authorized deep-link review. Reporting groups are not Jobs. Manpower Reporting records labor by reporting group, work date, worker, task, work identity, AM hours, PM hours, notes, and attribution. Persistent reporting groups organize entry and review; they are not jobs. Work identity is either a Production job or temporary label, never both. Workers and tasks are stable references with display order and active state. Historical references are deactivated rather than deleted. Total hours derive from AM plus PM and are not stored. Client-side search covers group, date, worker, task, job name/number, temporary label, notes, and entered-by. Search changes displayed rows and totals without changing persistence or ordering. excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Open Toolbox → Resources → Contacts. Search for the beginning of the customer’s company name, then select the company name to open Customer Inspector. Edit Customer / Company Name, or expand Additional Information (Optional) to edit Contact Name, Phone Number or Email Address. Choose Save Changes. Lead/Admin access is required to edit a saved customer; read-only accounts cannot save changes. Saved changes apply to future selections. Existing Jobs and Proposals keep their captured information.

outputs.question: How do I create a group conversation?

input.question: how do i create a group conversation

excerpts.title: Create a group conversation
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Open Messaging from the app header. Choose New group, enter a group name, select at least one other participant, then choose Create group. Only the creator can rename the group or add/remove participants. Current members share the full history; removed members lose access. Previously signed attachment links may remain usable for up to ten minutes.

excerpts.title: Messaging groups, personal DMs and conversation privacy
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Employees can create creator-managed groups, send messages and attachments, and reply within an authorized conversation. Adding a third person to an existing personal DM is not supported: create a separate group; old DM history stays private and is not copied. A dedicated Share Job control is not verified; do not invent it. Official TenOps system notices retain separate authority. TenBot receives no employee Messaging records. - My Work and Inbox are participant/private domains. Task estimated effort supports workload views; attachments and typing/Realtime authorization preserve private boundaries.

excerpts.guidance: Account decision: partial. Partially: you can start a new group, but you cannot add a third person to a personal DM. Create a new group instead. The old DM stays private and its history is not copied into the group.

excerpts.title: Reply to a specific employee message
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Employees with Messaging participation permission can reply inside a DM or group they are authorized to access. Open Messaging and the conversation, open Message actions on an ordinary employee message, and choose Reply. Type your reply and choose Send. The quoted preview links back to the original when it remains available to you. Replies stay in the same authorized conversation; they do not share the message with another conversation. Official system messages do not offer ordinary employee message actions.

excerpts.title: Send files or images in an employee conversation
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Employees with Messaging participation permission can send attachments inside an authorized DM or group. Open Messaging and the conversation, choose Attach, and select files. Supported browsers also allow pasting images or files, or dropping them into the composer. Review the attachments, optionally add text, then choose Send. Limits are 50 MB per file and 200 MB per message. Clipboard support varies by browser. The transfer must finish before the attachment message is delivered. Attachments remain subject to the conversation's access rules; do not send private records to TenBot.

outputs.question: How do I attach a Sample to a Bid?

input.question: how do i attach a sample to a bid

excerpts.title: Attach a Sample to a Bid
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Open Intake and select the Bid. In Tools, choose Open related Samples. In Bid-context Samples, choose an Existing standalone Sample, then Link Sample. A Sample already linked to another Bid cannot be moved by this action. To make a new Sample instead, choose Create Sample in the Bid’s Tools; the established generator retains Bid, Customer and Project context, then save the Sample. The Sample editor also provides Bid context when saving a draft. Existing generated documents are not changed by linking. Existing Intake-management, operational-read and business-write permissions are required.

excerpts.title: Bid-context Samples and existing Sample links
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. The released Bid-context Samples screen links an existing standalone Sample with Existing standalone Sample → Link Sample. A Sample already linked to another Bid cannot be reassigned by this action. Create Sample in Bid Tools starts a new canonical Sample with Bid, Customer and Project context. Existing generated documents are not changed. excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Samples and Blend Sheets use the established generator and saved/issued revisions. excerpts.title: Share a Job in a message
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: unverified. The TenOps Guide does not have enough verified information to confirm a dedicated Share Job control in Messaging. This does not mean the feature is unavailable. Please check with Product. Do not paste private Job records here.

excerpts.title: Messaging groups, personal DMs and conversation privacy
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Employees can create creator-managed groups, send messages and attachments, and reply within an authorized conversation. Adding a third person to an existing personal DM is not supported: create a separate group; old DM history stays private and is not copied. A dedicated Share Job control is not verified; do not invent it. Official TenOps system notices retain separate authority. TenBot receives no employee Messaging records. - My Work and Inbox are participant/private domains. Task estimated effort supports workload views; attachments and typing/Realtime authorization preserve private boundaries.

outputs.question: Can TenOps estimate material lead times?

input.question: can tenops estimate material lead times

excerpts.title: Material requirements and lead-time guidance
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: partial. Partly: released material-assessment services can combine exact saved Sample or issued Blend authority, reviewed Inventory mappings, catalog supplier evidence and documented manual lead-time estimates. Available stock, reservations, incoming ETAs and shortages remain distinct. Unknown evidence stays unknown; incoming supply is not on-hand stock. This is not automatic lead-time prediction from a Blend Sheet and does not promise a Production date. The current Bid Inspector does not expose the retained material-assessment editor, so I cannot provide an employee-facing assessment-button workflow. Formulations and Blend Sheets stay in Samples; ask Product about the assessment workflow. Assessment does not create reservations, orders or stock changes.

excerpts.title: Material requirements, supply evidence and lead-time boundaries
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: partial. Released retained scope/material services can calculate requirements from exact saved Sample/issued Blend authority and reviewed quantity/unit mappings, then distinguish available stock, own-Job reservations, reservations elsewhere, incoming supply and on-hand shortages. Supplier/catalog lead-time evidence or documented manual estimates may support assessment; unknown evidence remains unknown. Current Bid Inspector does not mount a material-assessment editor or Refresh read-only availability control. There is no verified automatic Blend Sheet lead-time prediction or promised Production date. No stock, reservation, order or material-status mutation occurs through read-only assessment. Formulations and Blend Sheets are authored in Samples; use existing supplier/catalog context and ask Product about an employee-facing assessment workflow.

raw.answer: TenOps can estimate material lead times using saved Sample or issued Blend authority, reviewed mappings, and documented manual estimates. However, it does not automatically predict lead times from a Blend Sheet or guarantee a Production date. The current system does not support an employee-facing assessment workflow or automatic updates to stock, reservations, or orders. You may need to consult Product for further details on the assessment process.
raw.summary: TenOps can estimate material lead times with manual input and existing data, but no automatic prediction or workflow is available.
